blocks.zh: Section 2: Post-Approval Change Management Protocol (PACMP)｜上市後變更管理計畫
blocks.en: Section 2: Post-Approval Change Management Protocol (PACMP)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 能夠精確定義 PACMP（Post-Approval Change Management Protocol，上市後變更管理計畫） 的本質：一份事先議定的「條件式監管協議」
blocks.en: Be able to define the nature of a PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol) precisely: a pre-agreed "conditional regulatory agreement"

blocks.zh: 掌握 PACMP 的 兩步驟執行流程（Step 1：協議核准；Step 2：執行並報告）及各步驟的法規意涵
blocks.en: Master the two-step implementation process of a PACMP (Step 1: protocol approval; Step 2: execution and reporting) and the regulatory implications of each step

blocks.zh: 理解 PACMP 的 七大核心要素，能夠評估一份 PACMP 文件的完整性
blocks.en: Understand the seven core elements of a PACMP and be able to assess the completeness of a PACMP document

blocks.zh: 了解 PACMP 修訂的條件，以及哪些情況需要 prior approval vs. notification
blocks.en: Understand the conditions for modifying a PACMP, and which situations require prior approval vs. notification

blocks.zh: 掌握 三種 PACMP 類型：單產品、跨產品、跨產品跨廠，以及各類型的適用場景與風險考量
blocks.en: Master the three types of PACMP: single-product, multi-product, and multi-product multi-site, with the applicable scenarios and risk considerations of each

blocks.zh: 4.1 Definition of a PACMP｜PACMP 定義
blocks.en: 4.1 Definition of a PACMP

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PACMP 的三個核心價值
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Core Values of a PACMP

blocks.zh: 可預期性（Predictability）：MAH 事先知道「若我做了這個變更，需要準備什麼數據、用什麼分類提交」，不再需要在實施前猜測監管機構的反應
blocks.en: Predictability: the MAH knows in advance "if I make this change, what data I need to prepare and which category to submit under", and no longer has to guess the regulator's reaction before implementation

blocks.zh: 透明性（Transparency）：監管機構事先了解 MAH 的變更計畫和科學依據，建立互信基礎
blocks.en: Transparency: the regulatory authority understands the MAH's change plan and scientific basis in advance, building mutual trust

blocks.zh: 效率提升：核准的 PACMP 通常可帶來更低的報告分類（如從 Prior Approval 降至 Notification）或更短的審核時間
blocks.en: Greater efficiency: an approved PACMP can usually bring a lower reporting category (for example, from Prior Approval down to Notification) or a shorter review time

blocks.zh: PACMP 的商業價值計算
blocks.en: The Business Value of a PACMP

blocks.zh:
無 PACMP 的流程：
  CMC 變更決策 → 準備 Prior Approval 申請
  → 提交 → 等待 3-12 個月 → 核准 → 實施
  總耗時：6-18 個月（含準備）

有 PACMP 的流程：
  事先提交 PACMP（通常隨 MAA 或早期提交）
  → 核准 PACMP → 執行研究 → 數據達標
  → 依 PACMP 分類提交（Notification 或更快）
  → 更短的等待期 → 實施
  實施前耗時：大幅縮短（可能只需 1-3 個月）

節省成本：
  · 更快速的製程優化 → 更早的 COGS 降低
  · 更可預期的時程 → 更精準的商業規劃
  · 減少重複溝通 → 降低行政成本
blocks.en:
Process without a PACMP:
  CMC change decision → prepare Prior Approval submission
  → submit → wait 3-12 months → approval → implement
  Total time: 6-18 months (including preparation)

Process with a PACMP:
  Submit PACMP in advance (usually with the MAA or an early submission)
  → PACMP approved → conduct studies → data meet criteria
  → submit under the PACMP category (Notification or faster)
  → shorter waiting period → implement
  Time before implementation: greatly reduced (possibly only 1-3 months)

Cost savings:
  · Faster process optimisation → earlier COGS reduction
  · More predictable timelines → more accurate commercial planning
  · Less repeated communication → lower administrative cost

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜PACMP 核准後仍需動態風險評估
blocks.en: Key Note | A PACMP still requires dynamic risk assessment after approval

blocks.zh: 原文有一個重要但容易被忽略的要點：PACMP 核准後，若有新資訊出現，MAH 在執行變更前必須重新評估原始 PACMP 中的風險評估是否仍然有效。若新資訊顯示風險增加，已核准的分類類別就不再適用——必須回到常規流程或諮詢監管機構。這說明 PACMP 是「條件式協議」，不是「免死金牌」。
blocks.en: The original text contains an important but easily overlooked point: after a PACMP is approved, if new information emerges, the MAH must, before implementing the change, re-evaluate whether the risk assessment in the original PACMP is still valid. If new information shows increased risk, the approved category no longer applies, and the change must return to the routine process or the regulatory authority must be consulted. This shows that a PACMP is a "conditional agreement", not a "free pass".

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜GMP 合規是 PACMP 執行的前提
blocks.en: Key Note | GMP compliance is a prerequisite for executing a PACMP

blocks.zh: 原文明確指出：執行 PACMP 的設施必須符合 GMP 要求及查廠/許可狀態。即便 PACMP 已核准，若設施在查廠中發現 GMP 缺失，仍無法在較低分類下執行變更。PACMP 降低的是「審核文件」的負擔，不能繞過「現場合規」的要求。
blocks.en: The original text states clearly that the facility executing a PACMP must meet GMP requirements and have an acceptable inspection/licensing status. Even if a PACMP has been approved, if an inspection finds GMP deficiencies at the facility, the change cannot be implemented under the lower category. A PACMP reduces the burden of "document review"; it cannot bypass the requirement for "on-site compliance".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明｜PACMP 像是「預先議定的工程變更協議」
blocks.en: Analogy | A PACMP is like a "pre-agreed engineering change agreement"

blocks.zh: 想像你是一家建設公司，經常需要修改建築設計（CMC 變更）。傳統做法是每次修改都重新申請許可。PACMP 就像是你向政府提交了一份「未來工程變更管理計畫」：「若我未來要更換 A 類建材，我會做以下測試，達到以下標準，然後只需在施工前兩週通知你」——政府提前核准了這個協議。之後真正要換材料時，做完測試、達標後，按協議通知，無需重新完整申請。
blocks.en: Imagine you are a construction company that often needs to modify building designs (CMC changes). The traditional approach is to apply for a permit again for every modification. A PACMP is like submitting to the government a "future engineering change management plan": "If I need to replace Type A building material in future, I will run the following tests, meet the following standards, and then only notify you two weeks before construction", and the government approves this agreement in advance. Later, when the material is actually replaced, once the tests are done and the standards are met, you notify as agreed, with no need to reapply in full.

blocks.zh: 但注意：若建材市場出現了新的安全資訊（新資訊），你必須重新評估原協議的假設是否還成立，不能盲目執行。
blocks.en: But note: if new safety information appears in the building materials market (new information), you must re-evaluate whether the assumptions of the original agreement still hold, and cannot execute blindly.

blocks.zh: 4.2 Application of a PACMP｜PACMP 的執行流程
blocks.en: 4.2 Application of a PACMP

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜驗收標準未達標 → 必須走常規流程
blocks.en: Key Note | Acceptance criteria not met → the routine process must be followed

blocks.zh: 這是 PACMP 的一個關鍵限制：若 Step 2 的研究結果未達到 Step 1 中設定的驗收標準，整個 PACMP 路徑即告失效，必須回到常規的監管申請路徑。這意味著設計 PACMP 時，驗收標準的設定至關重要——標準太嚴則執行困難，標準太寬則監管機構不接受。找到科學合理且可達成的標準，是 PACMP 成功的關鍵。
blocks.en: This is a key limitation of a PACMP: if the Step 2 study results do not meet the acceptance criteria set in Step 1, the whole PACMP pathway lapses and the change must return to the routine regulatory submission route. This means that setting the acceptance criteria is critical when designing a PACMP: criteria that are too strict are hard to meet, and criteria that are too loose will not be accepted by the regulator. Finding criteria that are scientifically sound and achievable is the key to PACMP success.

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜PACMP 不適用於需要臨床數據的變更
blocks.en: Key Note | A PACMP does not apply to changes that require clinical data

blocks.zh: 原文明確排除了需要臨床/非臨床/PK-PD 數據才能評估影響的變更——例如：
blocks.en: The original text explicitly excludes changes whose impact can only be assessed with clinical/non-clinical/PK-PD data, for example:

blocks.zh: 某些製劑配方變更（可能影響 bioavailability）
blocks.en: Certain formulation changes (which may affect bioavailability)

blocks.zh: 引入新雜質的製程變更（需毒理評估）
blocks.en: Process changes that introduce new impurities (requiring toxicological assessment)

blocks.zh: 生物製品的免疫原性評估
blocks.en: Immunogenicity assessment of biological products

blocks.zh: PACMP 的設計假設是：CMC 技術數據（物理化學、分析、製程性能）足以評估變更影響。一旦需要臨床數據，變更的科學和監管複雜性超出了 PACMP 機制的適用範疇。
blocks.en: A PACMP is designed on the assumption that CMC technical data (physicochemical, analytical, process performance) are sufficient to assess the impact of the change. Once clinical data are needed, the scientific and regulatory complexity of the change goes beyond what the PACMP mechanism can handle.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明｜Step 1 是「辦理通行證」，Step 2 是「實際過關」
blocks.en: Analogy | Step 1 is "getting the pass", Step 2 is "actually going through"

blocks.zh: PACMP 就像是申辦一張「特快速查驗通行證」：
blocks.en: A PACMP is like applying for an "expedited clearance pass":

blocks.zh: Step 1：你向海關（監管機構）提交申請，說明你通常攜帶的物品類型、你的安全記錄、以及你承諾在通過前會做哪些自我檢查——海關核准你的申請，給你一張通行證
blocks.en: Step 1: you submit an application to customs (the regulatory authority), describing the types of goods you usually carry, your safety record, and the self-checks you promise to carry out before crossing; customs approves your application and issues you a pass

blocks.zh: Step 2：每次實際過關時，你按承諾做自我檢查，達到標準後向海關報告，然後以快速通道通過——不需要每次重新完整填寫申報表
blocks.en: Step 2: each time you actually cross, you carry out the self-checks as promised, report to customs once the standards are met, and then go through the fast lane; you do not have to fill in the full declaration form again each time

blocks.zh: 但若你突然攜帶了通行證中未涵蓋的物品（未預期的重大變更），仍需走一般通道（常規申請）。
blocks.en: But if you suddenly carry items not covered by the pass (an unexpected major change), you still have to use the normal lane (routine submission).

blocks.zh: 4.3 Elements of a PACMP｜PACMP 的核心要素
blocks.en: 4.3 Elements of a PACMP

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜累積效應（Cumulative Effect）的管控
blocks.en: Key Note | Controlling the cumulative effect

blocks.zh: 原文特別強調：若 PACMP 涵蓋多個變更，必須評估這些變更的「累積效應」——即多個看似低風險的個別變更，組合在一起後的風險是否仍然可接受。這是製程驗證和風險管理中常常被忽視的面向。例如：更換原料藥供應商 + 調整包裝材料 + 更新分析方法，每個個別看起來低風險，但三者同時改變可能對整體品質控制造成衝擊。
blocks.en: The original text particularly stresses that if a PACMP covers multiple changes, the "cumulative effect" of those changes must be assessed, that is, whether the combined risk of several individually low-risk changes is still acceptable. This is an aspect often overlooked in process validation and risk management. For example: changing the drug substance supplier + adjusting the packaging material + updating the analytical method may each look low-risk individually, but changing all three at the same time could impact overall quality control.

blocks.zh: 實務應用｜CDMO 設計 PACMP 的實作要點
blocks.en: Practical Application | Practical points for a CDMO designing a PACMP

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 協助客戶（MAH）設計 PACMP 時，關鍵考量：
blocks.en: When a CDMO helps a client (the MAH) design a PACMP, the key considerations are:

blocks.zh: 驗收標準：必須既嚴格到讓監管機構接受降類，又實際可達成——建議基於歷史批次數據設定（±3σ 原則）
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria: they must be strict enough for the regulator to accept a lower category, yet realistically achievable; it is recommended to set them based on historical batch data (±3σ principle)

blocks.zh: 穩定性條件：與 Q12 Chapter 9 連結——確認性穩定性研究的設計應在 PACMP 中預先規劃
blocks.en: Stability conditions: linked to Q12 Chapter 9; the design of the confirmatory stability studies should be planned in advance in the PACMP

blocks.zh: 製程確效整合：若 PACMP 涉及製程變更，應與既有的 CPV（持續製程確效）計畫整合，避免重複性工作
blocks.en: Process validation integration: if the PACMP involves a process change, integrate it with the existing CPV (continued process verification) plan to avoid duplicated work

blocks.zh: 多廠地考量：若 PACMP 適用於多個 CDMO 廠址，各廠的 GMP 狀態和設備差異需要在 PACMP 中明確說明
blocks.en: Multi-site considerations: if the PACMP applies to several CDMO sites, the GMP status and equipment differences of each site must be stated clearly in the PACMP

blocks.zh: 4.4–4.5 Modification & Types of PACMPs｜PACMP 修訂與類型
blocks.en: 4.4-4.5 Modification & Types of PACMPs

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜「可重複使用」的 PACMP——高效率工具
blocks.en: Key Note | The "reusable" PACMP, a highly efficient tool

blocks.zh: 原文提到 PACMP 可以設計為「可重複使用」——例如，若某產品每三年都可能需要替換原料藥供應商，可以設計一個泛用性的 PACMP，規定「供應商替換時需做以下測試」。這樣只需一次性核准，之後每次替換時按協議執行 Step 2 即可，無需每次重新申請協議核准。這對管理多個高週轉率 CMC 變更的 CDMO 特別有價值。
blocks.en: The original text mentions that a PACMP can be designed to be "reusable". For example, if a product may need to change its drug substance supplier every three years, a generic PACMP can be designed that specifies "the following tests are to be done when the supplier is replaced". It then needs to be approved only once, and each later replacement simply follows the protocol at Step 2, with no need to obtain protocol approval again each time. This is particularly valuable for a CDMO managing many high-turnover CMC changes.

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜PACMP 修訂的觸發條件
blocks.en: Key Note | Triggers for modifying a PACMP

blocks.zh: 已核准的 PACMP 需要修訂時：
blocks.en: When an approved PACMP needs to be modified:

blocks.zh: 小幅修訂（如調整測試方法、更新驗收標準，但評估能力不降低）→ Notification 類型通知即可
blocks.en: Minor modification (such as adjusting a test method or updating acceptance criteria without reducing the ability to assess) → a Notification-type notice is enough

blocks.zh: 重大修訂（如協議內容有本質性改變）→ 需要 Prior Approval（修訂案）或提交全新協議
blocks.en: Major modification (such as a substantive change to the content of the protocol) → requires Prior Approval (of the amendment) or submission of an entirely new protocol

blocks.zh: 關鍵判斷標準是：修訂後的協議是否「仍具有相同或更強的評估能力」？若是，輕度通知即可；若否，需要更高層級的監管互動。
blocks.en: The key criterion is whether the modified protocol "still has the same or a greater ability to assess". If so, a light notification is enough; if not, a higher level of regulatory interaction is needed.

blocks.zh: 實務應用｜CDMO 的「平台級 PACMP」策略
blocks.en: Practical Application | The CDMO "platform-level PACMP" strategy

blocks.zh: 有遠見的 CDMO 可以發展「平台級 PACMP」——針對常見的跨產品 CMC 變更類型（如分析方法更新、包裝材料替換）設計標準化的協議框架，並與主要客戶（MAH）共同向監管機構申請跨產品 PACMP。這可以：
blocks.en: A forward-looking CDMO can develop a "platform-level PACMP": a standardised protocol framework for common cross-product CMC change types (such as analytical method updates and packaging material replacement), and apply to the regulatory authority for a multi-product PACMP together with its major clients (MAHs). This can:

blocks.zh: 大幅縮短每次 CMC 變更的實施週期
blocks.en: Greatly shorten the implementation cycle of each CMC change

blocks.zh: 建立 CDMO 的製程管理能力優勢，成為客戶選擇合作的競爭差異點
blocks.en: Build the CDMO's process management advantage and become a competitive differentiator when clients choose partners

blocks.zh: 降低多個客戶產品的變更管理總成本
blocks.en: Lower the total change management cost across multiple clients' products

blocks.zh: 這種「平台化」思維是 Q12 在 CDMO 商業模式中的高階應用。
blocks.en: This "platform" thinking is an advanced application of Q12 in the CDMO business model.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 設計一個跨產品 + 跨廠 PACMP 時，哪些因素會使「相同風險緩解策略」的假設失效？如何預防？
blocks.en: When designing a multi-product plus multi-site PACMP, which factors could invalidate the assumption of the "same risk mitigation strategy"? How can this be prevented?

blocks.zh: 若 PACMP Step 2 的穩定性數據不足以支持預設的驗收標準，MAH 有哪些選項？哪個選項風險最低？
blocks.en: If the stability data in Step 2 of a PACMP are insufficient to support the pre-set acceptance criteria, what options does the MAH have? Which option carries the lowest risk?

blocks.zh: 一個「可重複使用」的 PACMP，在哪些情況下可能需要撤銷或重新設計（而不只是修訂）？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances might a "reusable" PACMP need to be withdrawn or redesigned (rather than merely modified)?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: PACMP 本質：MAH 與監管機構之間「事先議定的條件式協議」——事先核准研究計畫和驗收標準，執行達標後以較低分類提交
blocks.en: Nature of a PACMP: a "pre-agreed conditional agreement" between the MAH and the regulatory authority: the study plan and acceptance criteria are approved in advance, and once the criteria are met, the change is submitted under a lower category

blocks.zh: 兩步驟流程：Step 1（提交協議 → 監管核准）→ Step 2（執行研究 → 達標後依議定分類報告）；任一步驟失敗則回到常規流程
blocks.en: Two-step process: Step 1 (submit protocol → regulatory approval) → Step 2 (conduct studies → report under the agreed category once criteria are met); failure at either step returns the change to the routine process

blocks.zh: 適用限制：需要臨床/非臨床/PK-PD 數據支持的變更不適用 PACMP；執行時設施必須符合 GMP 合規狀態
blocks.en: Limitations: changes that need clinical/non-clinical/PK-PD data to support them are not suitable for a PACMP; the facility must be in a GMP-compliant state at execution

blocks.zh: 七大核心要素：變更描述、研究計畫與驗收標準、控制策略評估、其他條件、歷史支撐數據、建議分類、持續驗證計畫
blocks.en: Seven core elements: description of the change, study plan and acceptance criteria, control strategy assessment, other conditions, supporting historical data, proposed category, and ongoing verification plan

blocks.zh: 累積效應：多重變更須額外評估組合風險，不能只看個別變更的風險
blocks.en: Cumulative effect: multiple changes require an additional assessment of the combined risk, not just the risk of each individual change

blocks.zh: 三種類型：單產品（含可重複使用型）、跨產品、跨產品跨廠——複雜性依次升高，但潛在效益也更大
blocks.en: Three types: single-product (including the reusable type), multi-product, and multi-product multi-site; complexity increases in that order, but so does the potential benefit

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略意涵：平台級 PACMP 是 CDMO 建立競爭優勢和降低客戶變更管理成本的重要工具
blocks.en: Implications for CDMO strategy: the platform-level PACMP is an important tool for a CDMO to build competitive advantage and reduce clients' change management cost
